name: hdri-look-and-fog
prompt: Using the 67js MCP tools and the build-67js-scene skill: make a small outdoor-style scene (a ground slab and a sphere). Light it with a catalog HDRI as the visible sky if one works (otherwise a light setup), apply a color look, and add volume fog with multiple scattering if the tools allow it (otherwise plain volume fog). Look at it, then finish by calling scene_export_recipe. If a call fails, do not loop: use the closest thing that works.
expected: The agent called scene_asset_catalog and ends with a recipe that has a sky (environment.hdri or a setup), a color look, volume fog with density above 0, and a scene_look after the last edit. Strict target once issues 661 and 664 are fixed: hdri sky-clouds, look teal-orange, volumeFog.scatterOctaves 3.
